data.title: Elfsborg and Malmo draw as Halmstad strengthen survival bid - TribalFootball.com
data.content:
Taonsa was again wasteful after the break, while Ronning kept Halmstad alive by denying Mamadou Diagne a spectacular second. Those moments proved crucial, as four minutes from time Gabriel Wallentin lumped the ball forward, and Pascal Gregor used his head to loop it over Elis Jager to level. [...] And two minutes into added time, HBK went and won it when Hussein Carneil cut in from the left side and sent a 20-yard curler through a crowd and past Jager before he could react. Halmstad have won two of their last four, as many as in their first 21, while Vasteras remain in sixth place.

Elfsborg 0-0 Malmo [...] Both goalkeepers were forced into action in the first half, with the visitors' Tim Ronning doing brilliantly to deny Axel Taonsa when one-on-one, but his resistance was broken in the final minute of the half, when Jonathan Karlsson opened up his body and guided the ball around the goalkeeper.
